objective: Complete compact executive visual adjustments to Home, Profile, Connect and Kingdom; protect legible text in dark-mode themes, consistent margins and accessible actions with owner-skipped physical device verification.
productionBaselineEvidence: Published staging-user source ab864a2b17e6078252be8ff8c7ce067043c7ce1c, runtime 1.3.2, Android package org.mzbministry.buklod.staging, verified in run 43682542706; production unchanged. New scope only for isolated staging changes.
chosenApproach: Apply semantic accessibility colors and compact shared layout tokens to targeted visible screens; retain all existing backend, navigation, advertising, video and account operations. Use CI and exact-source staging proof, waive only physical handset acceptance.
selectionRationale: A narrow visual-only patch minimizes regression and bundle size and removes wasted space without introducing native code, data migrations, new services or altered business rules.
alternativeApproaches: Replace all app layouts with a new CSS styling/runtime engine (rejected as unbounded risk and native rebuild).
Shrink typography and tap targets to fit more content (rejected as inaccessible).
Tighten app-wide semantic color and selected layout tokens while preserving 48px touch actions (selected).
preserveBehaviors: Keep original Home section order and lazy load gates, contribution data isolation, estimated earnings disclaimers and existing ads.
Keep scope-specific Cluster navigation, message privacy, HIBLA Connect, keyboard/PPT/call functionality and right-to-left system layout unaffected.
Keep original Kingdom entry route, 13 character centers, rewards/gameplay/ads and graphics; only compact promo card.
Keep Wall/Marites scroll-stop, NativeAd prefetch, media quality and safe IGPAT retirement unchanged.
Keep existing native package, Expo 1.3.2 runtime, staging and production channel isolation; on-device visual check explicitly skipped by owner.
acceptanceChecks: All 12 palettes >=4.5:1 for text-muted against common surfaces with contrast-aware action text.
Home contribution and Kingdom cards compact without truncation/forced fixed-height text or changed protected business logic.
Connect inline surfaces use palette semantics in dark mode and retain critical messaging behaviors.
Automated scope and focused test gates and TypeScript/Android compilation must pass before staging OTA.
Exact-source staging update and unchanged production are independently verified; physical on-device check waived.
